target_variable: Angiographic coronary artery disease (>50% diameter narrowing)
selection_rationale: Logistic Regression achieved the highest discriminatory power (0.968 ROC-AUC) and high screening sensitivity (0.929 Recall) across all candidate models. Crucially, Logistic Regression generates smooth, well-calibrated posterior probabilities via the logistic sigmoid link function, avoiding artificial probability step discontinuities and aligning with international cardiovascular risk scoring standards.
